resources.string: Everything happens on your phone. No internet, no sign-up, and your messages are never saved.
Lets SpamShield check each call as it comes in and quietly silence or hang up on the spam ones — before your phone even rings.
Make SpamShield your texting app so it can keep spam out of your inbox. Your texts stay in your phone\'s normal message storage — SpamShield never copies what they say.
SpamShield can\'t stop spam from being sent to your phone. What it does is step in the moment a call or text arrives — silencing it, hanging up, or moving it out of sight before it bothers you.
Nothing blocked yet — you\'re all set.
Spam call protection is off — tap to turn it on
Spam text filtering is off — tap to turn it on
